page.overview:
Who is Borri Bonehammer?

Borri Bonehammer was once an aspiring engineer. However, he took the Slayer Oath after being caught stealing guild secrets from the Engineers Guild of Zhufbar. His days of tinkering long past, Borri can now be found wandering the fringes of Sylvania, searching for his doom amongst the undead there. Although he may join a dwarfen army or caravan that happens to be passing through, he will not leave Sylvania until his debt is paid.
